summary: Implemented a verified-provider, owner-only advertising request projection with strict state, history, quote, payment-proof, and Africa/Cairo schedule projections, bounded filters/pagination, deterministic ordering, IDOR protection, and redacted administrative/storage fields.

verification.command: npm.cmd run build --workspace packages/contracts; npm.cmd run typecheck --workspace apps/api; node --test --import tsx apps/api/tests/provider/service.test.ts
verification.notes: Contracts/API typecheck passed and six focused provider tests passed.

verification.command: npm.cmd run lint; npm.cmd test -- --runInBand; npm.cmd run build
verification.notes: Lint passed; full suite passed 361 tests; build succeeded.

verification.command: npm.cmd audit --audit-level=high; npm.cmd run api:inventory; npm.cmd run openapi:validate; npm.cmd run postman:validate; node agent_pack/scripts/audit_pack.mjs; git diff --check
verification.notes: No high-severity vulnerabilities; inventory, OpenAPI, Postman, Agent Pack audit, and whitespace checks passed.

knownGaps: The projection consumes a source adapter; persistent cross-module advertising repository and HTTP route composition are not available in this atomic provider boundary.
Payment proof and schedule values are projected only from their authoritative services; this task does not infer payment, bank, approval, or provider verification.
Live database/provider integration checks were not run because no isolated replica-set topology or credentials were available.
